svg.title: Customer Assistant — AIA+ Deep Link Sequence
svg.desc: Seven participants: Customer, Chatbot, Agent, Skill, MCP, KB, AIA+. A clarification loop establishes the intent. The approved knowledge skill retrieves service guidance through MCP and KB. The Agent identifies an AIA+ self-service path and invokes the service-destination skill. MCP calls AIA+ to obtain the actual deep link and sign-in requirements. The Chatbot displays the link. In an optional customer-initiated continuation, the customer opens AIA+, signs in as required and completes the self-service workflow. The service result is displayed in AIA+ and is not automatically sent to Chatbot or Agent. Twenty-four numbered messages, editable text, transparent canvas.

g.text: Repeat as needed, within configured clarification limits.
Present the Link & Continue in AIA+
Customer Chooses to Continue in AIA+
Self-service and its result stay in AIA+.

g.aria-label: 15 Resolve Link for the Target Service
g.text: 15 Resolve Link for the Target Service

g.aria-label: 22 Display Sign-In or Target Service Screen
g.text: 22 Display Sign-In or Target Service Screen

g.aria-label: 23 Sign In as Required & Complete Self-Service
g.text: 23 Sign In as Required & Complete Self-Service
